projects.name: Carevoice App
projects.description: **CareVoice** is an AI-powered reporting assistant designed to reduce the administrative workload for nurses. My UX/UI mission was to create a simple, intuitive experience that helps nurses quickly create, review, and send medical reports while keeping them in control of the process.
